product.description: Dynamic handheld microphones are the most popular and commonly used type of mic. They are perfect for live performances and speech, but can be used in a number of other applications, including recording, podcasting, streaming, WFH, distance learning, and more. Because of the wide range of applications, dynamic mics are available with an equally wide range of quality options, from good sounding expensive microphones to cheap poorly built ones. The Stage Right™ DM20 Dynamic Vocal Handheld Microphone bridges the best of both worlds, delivering a professional sounding and well built microphone at a fraction of the cost.
